name: bkit
description: Classical machine learning for Bantu: scikit-learn's shape, with a histogram-based gradient-boosting implementation inside it rather than beside it. Phases K1-K2 of twelve: the estimator protocol (fit/predict/transform/get_params/set_params/clone, with fit_transform/score/_check_fitted provided), Pipeline with step__param addressing and a deep clone, the table-driven protocol check every later estimator is measured against, and eleven preprocessing transformers -- four scalers sharing one transform, three encoders mapping through searchsorted, SimpleImputer, PolynomialFeatures, Normalizer and Binarizer.
